organization.address_note_cs: Sídlo je zapsaná adresa společnosti, ne kancelář pro veřejnost. Schůzky domlouváme předem — nejčastěji u vás nebo online. Nejrychleji se ozveme na e-mail nebo telefon.
organization.address_note_en: This is the company’s registered address, not a walk-in office. Meetings are arranged in advance — usually at your place or online. E-mail or phone gets the fastest reply.
organization.address_note_rule: Never print the address without this note next to it: it is a private residence. Any surface that shows the address (contact page, footer, JSON-LD consumers, invoices, directory listings) must make clear that visitors are seen by appointment only.
organization.origin_note_cs: Iterus je softwarová značka společnosti SUN Professionals s.r.o. Firma působí na trhu od roku 2005, dosud v oboru stínicí techniky. Software pod značkou Iterus stavíme od roku 2025.
organization.origin_note_en: Iterus is the software brand of SUN Professionals s.r.o. The company has traded since 2005, until now in the shading-technology sector. Software under the Iterus brand has been built since 2025.
organization.founder_name_note: One canonical spelling in both locales — a person is one entity, and Person/Organization JSON-LD, LinkedIn and the company register must agree. The alternate is the diacritics-free form for Person.alternateName only; never use it in page copy.
organization.founder_story_cs: Za Iterem stojí Tomáš Kučera. Technika mě zajímala vždycky a vlastní aplikace jsem chtěl stavět roky — vedle podnikání na to ale nikdy nezbýval čas. Změnily to jazykové modely a nástroje jako Claude Code a Codex: cesta od záměru k běžící aplikaci se zkrátila natolik, že dávalo smysl začít. Začal jsem nástroji pro vlastní firmu, kde jsem znal problém nejlíp a případnou chybu odnesl sám. Fungovaly, tak jsem pokračoval — a z toho vznikl Iterus.
organization.founder_story_en: Iterus is run by Tomáš Kučera. Technology has always interested me, and I wanted to build my own applications for years — running a business never left the time for it. Language models and tools like Claude Code and Codex changed that: the path from intent to a running application got short enough to be worth taking. I started with tools for my own company, where I knew the problem best and carried the cost of any mistake myself. They worked, so I kept going — and Iterus came out of it.
organization.founder_story_note: Drafted 2026-09-09 from Tomas's own account and approved by him on 2026-09-11. Deliberately framed around time and priorities, never ability: CLAUDE.md forbids the site stating that Tomas is a programmer and equally forbids stating or implying that he is not. Place it on /o-nas AFTER the paragraph about what we have built, never before it — alone the story reads as a hobby origin, next to the evidence it explains why the brand is young.

how_we_work.approved_cs: Pracujeme AI-native: vývoj akcelerujeme nástroji Claude Code a Codex, kvalitu jistíme automatizovanými testy, nezávislým code review a specialisty na vyžádání.
how_we_work.approved_en: We work AI-native: delivery is accelerated with Claude Code and Codex, and quality is secured by automated tests, independent code review and specialists on demand.
how_we_work.ai_review_findings_note: Tomas, 2026-09-15: roughly two of three findings from delegated AI review do not survive verification against the code or a measurement — the reason a human, not the model, decides what is merged. Measured on the Innea delegation log, not a general statistic, so the published sentence is scoped to Innea. Rendered only through <HowWeWork statement="review-yield" />, never retyped in prose.
how_we_work.review_yield_cs: Poctivý dodatek: u Innea zhruba dva ze tří nálezů AI review při ověření proti kódu neobstojí. Právě proto rozhoduje člověk — a proto na výsledku záleží, kdo ho vede.
how_we_work.review_yield_en: An honest footnote: on Innea, roughly two out of three AI-review findings do not survive verification against the code. That is exactly why a human decides — and why it matters who leads the work.

pricing._readme: Approved by Tomas 2026-09-09. Amounts in CZK excluding VAT. reference_rate_czk_hour is the sanity check the bands were set against, not a formula that reproduces them: implied_hours records what each band's entry price buys at that rate. Never publish a band that is not listed here.

bands.includes_cs: Funkční pilot v provozu: přihlášení, databáze, jedna až dvě integrace, testy, nasazení.
bands.includes_en: A working pilot in production: authentication, database, one or two integrations, tests, deployment.

bands.includes_cs: Role a oprávnění, platby, administrace, více integrací, e2e testy, CI a monitoring.
bands.includes_en: Roles and permissions, payments, admin, multiple integrations, e2e tests, CI and monitoring.

bands.includes_cs: Napojení modelu na firemní data, kontrola kvality odpovědí, transparenční vrstva. On-premise nasazení začíná výš kvůli hardwaru a provozu; hardware není v ceně.
bands.includes_en: Connecting a model to company data, answer-quality controls and a transparency layer. On-premise deployment starts higher because of hardware and operations; hardware is not included.

discovery.cs: Placené discovery za 25 000 Kč — zadání, architektura a odhad. Částka se odečítá z ceny navazujícího projektu.
discovery.en: A paid discovery for 25,000 CZK — scope, architecture and estimate. The fee is deducted from the price of the follow-up project.

pricing.reference_rate_note: Decided by Tomas 2026-09-15: the hourly rate stays unpublished. /cena shows bands only, even though it targets the phrase 'hodinová sazba programátora' — the pricing model itself (bands, not hourly billing) is the answer to that search intent.
